# Propulsion data notes

The winged-cone map reconstructs NASA TP-3525 conceptual simulation functions. Enforce the source 10–200 lbm/s fuel-flow limits and 0.5 s first-order response externally.

The Orion catalog provides exact summary values, not downloadable pointwise time histories. The three curve files use plot-informed smooth shapes whose exponents are solved so numerical integration matches the source burn time, maximum thrust, and total impulse.

These are research surrogates, not certified manufacturer thrust histories. Catalog and Pegasus User Guide values remain separate because integrated-stage definitions and included hardware differ.
